# Auto Update Docs

After completing an accepted code change, review and update the documentation
that describes the changed behavior, commands, paths, or usage.

- Update only the relevant README, agent instructions, or configuration docs.
- Keep examples and file paths consistent with the implementation.
- Do not add documentation for changes that do not affect user-facing behavior,
  repository workflows, or contributor guidance.
- Validate documentation references before finishing.
